experiment.name: Event 1 Rising-Limb River Stage Forecast Evaluation
experiment.station: Vishnupuri Barrage, Godavari River, Nanded, Maharashtra

1h.rain_reason: Authentic catchment rainfall is only available starting July 31 05:00 IST. In the training window (July 4 to July 31 23:00 IST), there are only 18 observed rainfall hours. Features requiring up to 24h accumulation yield exactly 0 eligible training rows. A 14-parameter Ridge model cannot be trained on 0 observations without data fabrication.

1_stage_causality.details: All stage features at issue time t use shifts >= 0 (feat_stage_t is H(t), lags are t-1, t-2, t-3, diffs use past observations, rolling mean uses past 6h). Zero observations after t are accessed.

2_rainfall_causality.details: Rainfall features are lagged by shift(1) so only observations strictly prior to t (<= t-1) enter features. Rainfall at or after t is strictly excluded.

3_target_separation.details: Target is stage(t+h) with h in {1, 2, 3}. Forecast delta is target_stage - stage(t). Future target values never enter the feature matrix X.

4_chronological_training.details: Training targets are strictly restricted to dt + h <= 2024-07-31 23:00 IST. Zero observations from the embargo period (Aug 1 00:00 - Aug 3 09:00) or test period enter model fitting.

5_scaler_isolation.details: StandardScaler is fitted exclusively on X_train. Test data is transformed using scaler.transform() without refitting. Zero test statistics leak into the scaler.

6_missing_rainfall.details: No zero-imputation, .bfill(), or .ffill() was applied to rainfall. Missing rainfall remains strictly NaN. The training feasibility gate halted rainfall model training due to missing data rather than imputing zeros.

7_paired_comparison.details: Persistence and Water-Level-Only Ridge regression are evaluated on 100% identical test forecast origins at each horizon (34 origins for 1h, 33 for 2h, 32 for 3h).

8_hyperparameter_isolation.details: Ridge alpha is fixed at 10.0 (identical to repository baseline). No hyperparameter tuning or feature selection was performed on the rising limb test period.

9_output_provenance.details: Every row in event1_rising_limb_predictions.csv contains explicit issue timestamp, target timestamp, horizon, model, predicted stage, actual stage, and absolute error.
